messages:
morgan_support: Escalation - DataScribe trial search embeddings producing low-relevance results; customers report onboarding search returns unrelated docs. Reported 09:05 UTC and customer demo + renewal review in 48h. Marking high priority.

morgan_support: sample log from embed pipeline:
```text
[2026-03-25T09:03:12Z] EMBED_INDEX job=idx-447 status=completed model=embed-v2.1 unusual_dist=0.47
[2026-03-25T09:03:14Z] QUERY user=admin@datascribe.com q=\"invoice\" top_hit_score=0.12 expected>0.6
```

alert_bot: Incident created: INC-2040-501; severity=high; routed to eng-ml.

elaine_cs: I can take comms. Need exact org id, contact emails, and whether this started after the model swap last night. Also flagging renewal: primary contact requested health update ahead of Friday call. @ryan_prod can you confirm model changes?

morgan_support: Org: datascribe-trial-21. POC: anna@datascribe.com (product lead). Issue appears ~03:00 UTC after we promoted embed-v2.1 as default for trials. Attached ticket ST-11522 with example queries.

ryan_prod: Confirmed we routed trials to embed-v2.1 at 02:45 UTC to improve latency. Early telemetry shows higher l2 distance for many short queries. Quick mitigation: pin org to embed-v2.0 or re-index with tuned parameters. Command to pin model per-org:
```bash
redwood-admin org-config set --org datascribe-trial-21 --key embed_model --value embed-v2.0
```
I can pin now if support approves. Longer-term: revert default rollout and run A/B with eval set.

nora_am: Please pin to v2.0 immediately. Renewal convo relies on reliable search in demo. I'll prepare a customer note offering a follow-up quality review and a one-week performance guarantee as a gesture.

morgan_support: Created CR-10077 authorizing per-org model pin. Added renewal flag in SFDC.

ryan_prod: Pinning embed-v2.0 for datascribe-trial-21 now and triggering a reindex. Will post results.

ryan_prod: Done  embed_model=embed-v2.0 applied, reindex job started. Quick verification: sample query \"invoice\" now returns top_hit_score=0.78 -> 200 OK.

elaine_cs: Sending customer note: short apology, confirmation of temporary pin + reindex, invite to 20-min QA call before demo, and offer of performance review + one-week guarantee. Nora, please review tone.

nora_am: Draft looks good. I'll join the QA call and include a renewal-friendly line. Also set renewal risk=mitigated for now but mark for follow-up after A/B results.

morgan_support: Leaving ST-11522 open until we confirm long-term rollout plan. Support will monitor embed similarity metrics and alerts.

alert_bot: Incident INC-2040-501 status -> mitigated; follow-up task TASK-5629 created: \"evaluate embed-v2.1 on short-query eval set\".

elaine_cs: Recap owners: (1) CS: send comms + run QA call (elaine_cs) (2) AM: renewal framing + join QA (nora_am) (3) Eng: pin + reindex + run A/B eval (ryan_prod) (4) Support: monitor and keep ticket open (morgan_support). :thumbsup:
